description: Places the framework's session rules, `hooks/rules.md`, into every session at start and into every subagent at spawn of a project that declares `siegard.json`, and the drift a project is already carrying into every session at start; answers every stop of a session whose project holds a goal armed by `bin/goal.py --arm` from that goal's state, and, in a project that holds none, holds the message a session stops on to what `bin/handoff.py --check` decides — measured by default, and blocked once with the next stop allowed only where `SIEGARD_HANDOFF_STOP` is `enforce`; and refuses a commit that adds to an orchestration log a `decided:` or `recommended:` line out of the form the handoff states, or a judged `decided:` line no armed goal granted.
